cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Of course your brother can stay for dinner. I'll give him my pie. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Please don't worry. There are peas, and I had a substantial breakfast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order you a pizza. It takes forty minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How thoughtful. I'll keep everyone company while they eat, then you can all watch me have dinner at nine.

mechanism: A confidently hosts an extra diner and accepts B food solution while graciously making the longer wait and surrendered dinner visible.
confusable: Unlike demanding an apology, A stays accommodating and does not set a price; borrowed authority bends meal timing to preserve everyone cooperation.
comparison: Dinner sacrifice and delayed replacement differ from carrying books through a changed station route.
seedUse: Use D45-a pie/peas/pizza delay and S02-a treating an adjusted arrangement as a managed plan.
